text:
ryan: quick heads-up — release notes draft pushed to /releases/2026.03.21. SBOM scan flagged an unclear license on transitive lib 'fastpath-utils' (no SPDX). Should we pin, hotpatch, or short rollback?

marta: can you paste the deploybot output?

ryan: sure — deploy-bot output below:
```
deploy-bot: sbom-scan: failure
component: fastpath-utils@2.1.0 (transitive)
issue: missing-spdx-identifier
severity: low-medium
affected-environment: canary-eu
```

ryan: only hit canary-eu so far. canary-us + staging passed.

devon: low-medium = policy threshold for auto-hold? I thought threshold was medium.

jules: ours is configured to hold on medium+, but legal asked to surface low-medium if signature / provenance missing. legal-qa-bot, any guidance?

legal-qa-bot: @jules we prefer pin-to-digest where feasible and include a note in release notes. If provenance can't be established in 24h escalate to sec for rollback.

marta: operationally easiest: pin canary-eu to previous base image + mark canary-eu as quiesced. That buys time and keeps prod rollout in other regions moving.

devon: agree. Steps: 1) rollback canary-eu to image digest: sha256:abcd... (previous) 2) mark canary as "limited" in console 3) add release note entry: "EU canary temporarily limited due to SBOM provenance follow-up"

ryan: I'll update release notes copy. What's the exact rollback command?

deploy-bot: `redeploy --cluster=canary-eu --image=registry/redwood/service:20260320-sha256-abcd1234 --reason="sbom-provenance-ack"`

jules: also file a short eval: who pulled that transitive lib? maybe the dependency was introduced by the new tokenizer. devon can you run `git bisect` on the lockfile?

devon: on it. starting bisect on lockfile now. ETA ~30m.

ryan: ryan -> I'll push the release notes update (short blurb) and add an action item pointing to this thread. Can someone grant a quick 👍 when the rollback is done so I can unhold the release notes?

marta: doing the rollback now. will report back. :hammer_and_wrench:

deploy-bot: redeploy started (job id: 2026-3765), progress: 0%

marta: redeploy completed. canary-eu now pinned to sha256-abcd1234. health checks green.

devon: bisect done — fastpath-utils came in via tokenizer v1.4.3 in PR #842. Opening PR to pin tokenizer dep to v1.4.2 and add SBOM metadata.

legal-qa-bot: once PR lands, request a re-run of sbom scan and provenance attach (cosign). If cosign not available for that component, escalate.

ryan: release notes updated:
- "Canary (EU) temporarily limited due to SBOM provenance follow-up for transitive dependency fastpath-utils. No user-facing impact. We will reopen region after provenance is confirmed or a pinned build is deployed."

jules: thanks. i'll add a runbook snippet under /runbooks/release/sbom-ack.md with steps we took.

marta: closing loop — rollout for other regions continues. tagging @oncall for FYI. :white_check_mark:
